answer: Make earnings convex in a key's unbroken track record. Each key's reward rate is its base rate times one plus a small bonus per consecutive passing epoch, capped at 3x after about 200 epochs, and a single slash resets the streak. Like a glacier, standing builds slowly and melts fast. An operator splitting the same work across ten fresh keys earns far less than one long-lived key, and that delta widens every epoch, so the velvet-lined path is to keep one identity and keep it clean.
